For applicant, part 1
APPLICATION FOR CERTIFICATE OF ELIGIBILITY
Nationality/Region
Date of birth
Name
Passport
Date of expiration
Purpose of entry: check one of the followings
Intended length of stay
Intended place to apply for visa
Past entry into / departure from Japan
Family in Japan (father, mother, spouse, children, siblings,grandparents, uncle, aunt or others) and cohabitants

For applicant, part 2  P ("Student")
Place of study
Total period of education (from elementary school to last institution of education)
Education (last school or institution) or present school
Method of support to pay for expenses while in Japan(fill in with regard to living expenses, tuition and rent) * multiple answers possible
Method of support and an amount of support per month (average)
Supporter(If there is more than one, give information on all of the supporters )*another paper may be attached, which does not have to use a prescribed format.

For applicant, part 3  P ("Student")
Relationship with the applicant
Organization which provide scholarship
Plans after graduation
Signature of the applicant (representative) / Date of filling in this form
The date of preparation of the application form must be written by the applicant (representative).

For organization, part 1  P ("Student")
Name of the foreigner to enter school
Place of Study
Date of entrance
Lesson hours per week(including scheduled lessons)
Registration

For organization, part 2  P ("Student")
Faculty / Course
Research room
Name of mentoring professor
(If you are an exchange student, fill in the expiration date of the exchange student acceptance period in (11))
Month and year of expiration of the exchange student acceptance period
Name of the educational institution and representative of the educational institution ／Date of filling in this form

note_zh: 現連2026-v3 Excel實際含五張工作表與預填記入例，非全空白。五張原生正文已逐欄讀；公開僅必要欄位摘錄，不公開範例姓名、護照、帳戶／金額、研究室或既勾選內容。學生三sheet、接收機構二sheet分開，不將範例金額當門檻。
